def mk(extra):
    def f(p,t,P):
        c,d,e,f_,w,g,k,h=p[:8]

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sin(p[5]*t); c = np.cos(p[5]*t)
    g = p[2] + p[3]*t + p[4]*s + p[6]*c + p[7]*np.exp(-p[8]*t) + p[9]*np.log(t)
    return p[0]*t + p[1]*P*np.log(P) + g/P
